name: publicWeb_getGeography
description: The cascading Country → Region → City lists for the hashruns.org/add-kennel form (E12.F1.S7), so a request names the database's own places instead of free text. The same lists hcportal_getCountries / getRegions / getCities give an authenticated admin; this one is anonymous and reference data only. One door, three questions: no parameters → every live country; @countryId → that country's live regions; @regionId → that region's live cities (@regionId wins when both are given). Read-only.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: Return this country's regions (ignored when @regionId is given).

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Return this region's cities. Takes precedence over @countryId.

rowsets.name: Places

columns.name: name
columns.description: City.CityName (NVARCHAR(100)) / Region.RegionName (NVARCHAR(100)) / Country.CountryName (NVARCHAR(250)) — typed by the branch taken.

rowsets.description: One rowset whose source depends on the parameters: HC.City (CityName), HC.Region (RegionName) or HC.Country (CountryName), Removed = 0, ordered by name. Empty for an unknown id.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
